text:
Lina: quick design thread about stacktrace copy + inline actions in request drilldown. Proposal: show a compact \"Copy stacktrace\" action per frame group and keep export options in kebab. Also add header-level bulk-download. mock: https://figma.redwood/stack-compact-v3
Evan: inline copy is handy for triage. prefer Copy + Open-in-trace as icons; put Download JSON / Download text under kebab.
Priya: copy format: include a small header so pasted text is self-describing. e.g. "-- Stacktrace (corr: 9b3f) 2026-02-11T09:22Z --" then frames, then "-- end --". makes parsing easier.
Zoe: accessibility: copy confirmation must be announced via aria-live, not only a visual toast. icons need aria-labels; avoid title-only.
Lina: behavior note: keep copy visible on hover & focus, but ensure it's tabbable after the frame content. keyboard order: frames -> Copy -> Open -> kebab.
Evan: perf: render copy/open for visible rows only; virtualize frames. For large tables, consider a header bulk-copy that operates on selected rows to avoid many buttons.
Priya: filenames for downloads should be stacktrace-<corr>-<shortts>.txt or .json. include corr id to help correlate with server logs.
Zoe: a11y nit: when frames are collapsed into "Show more frames" ensure the button has aria-expanded and the hidden count is in sr-only text. focus-visible must be defined for icons (2px solid token color).
design-bot: Accessibility checklist: aria-labels for actions, aria-live confirmation for copy, aria-expanded on collapsible frames, keyboard order rules, visible focus styles, and skip-links for screen reader users to jump to actions.
Lina: decision proposal: show Copy + Open inline (visible on hover/focus); put Download JSON/Text and Export HAR under kebab; add bulk-download in header; add aria-live copy confirmation; filenames include corr id + ts; responsive behavior: at <=880px collapse all actions under kebab.
Evan: I'll prototype keyboard flow and virtualize frames in the demo branch.
Priya: I'll draft exact copy templates and clipboard header examples.
Zoe: I'll add focus-visible tokens and collapse/expand aria spec to the component docs.
Lina: action items: Evan -> keyboard + perf prototype (due Wed), Priya -> copy templates (Tue), Zoe -> focus token + aria docs (Mon), Lina -> update RD-8230 with decision and add Figma link.
design-bot: Linked ticket RD-8230 updated with summary.
